summary: Replace snapshot-only CAM math with native 30-day spend objectives over authenticated, bounded producer/mirror source chains.

replay.detail: Native spend mirrors replay indexed durable usage observations in bounded pages and retain historical timely credit dispositions independently of terminal-state heads. Database identity, source epoch and configured writers fence cached cursors; restart rebuilds the disposable mirror from retained claims. Existing observations remain readable but do not assert completeness.

schema.detail: usage.limits.observed adds optional source_frontier, period_readings and gaps fields, plus optional nullable provider_plan on account-bearing nested objects. Frontiers bind original host, fixed account/plan roster, incarnation, sequence and actual accepted predecessor claim ID. At most 128 quota, credit, period and gap facts share one delta. Natural-period unused fractions are upper bounds, not fabricated exact forfeitures. Unsupported account gaps retain original source clocks without inventing canonical account digests.

rules.detail: Durable observation retention is unchanged. The obsolete latest-credit projection and its background backfill are removed. On open, the old usage_credit_claim_insert trigger and local_usage_credit_heads/pending/progress tables are dropped; all authoritative usage claims remain intact and rebuild the new disposable native mirror.

compatibility.detail: Native row IDs are now lowercase spend/cam-r01/PROVIDER and spend/cam-r02/PROVIDER, selectable by the existing native spend owner family; uppercase aliases are removed. R01 integrates the rolling 30d confirmed credit-loss gauge <=5 for 95% of covered time, with native paired burns. The combined provider-plan gauge adds conservative natural-period bounds under the same policy. R02 measures 95% timely dispositions for the trailing 30d entry cohort; failed result events occur at expiry so short burns see overdue work. Pending credits do not hide established misses. Older strict schema readers must be upgraded before receiving the new optional fields; no frozen client transport/codegen surface changes are included.

downtime.detail: No deployment or activation is performed. Store open does not synchronously replay spend history; startup, source gaps and incomplete mirror closure remain unknown rather than manufacturing success.

manual.detail: Prepare explicit host-scoped authorized producer identities and the full expected writer roster on each mirror. Commission a durable forward source journal, recording native accepted predecessor claim IDs before sealing subsequent immutable requests. A gap, replacement journal or changed account/plan roster starts a new incarnation with a genuine coverage start, clamped by native enrollment acceptance. Complete CAM R02 history requires 31 days of continuous source coverage; full 30d rolling-loss gauge recovery may require 60 days. Bind the native spend family to the intended owner using existing native objective policy.

recovery.detail: Retain durable observations through rollback and restore. Regenerate native mirrors from those claims after upgrade; missing source dependencies remain pending. Combined loss uses conservative credit/natural-period bounds and leaves threshold-crossing uncertainty unknown. Eligible-route readiness, terminal quota-attributed harm and billed overage remain explicitly not measured until their actual runtime or billing producers are commissioned; quota percentages are never substituted.
